g.text: HTTP Session Model and Deep-Thinking Confirmed Configuration
read Agent binding and current model_id
[target model does not support deep thinking]
atomically update model, thinking, and ETag
atomically update deep-thinking switch and ETag
The public models field is a string array of model_id values.
Names and display metadata come from the caller model catalog.
The current model can be absent when it was disabled later.
thinking controls whether deep thinking is enabled.
It never authorizes raw reasoning-content disclosure.
The change applies only to executions accepted afterward.
